'''Tosh''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhamalai]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] informed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Naem Yrros|Yrros]] that the security systems were not yet installed on the planet, but Yrros replied that acquiring food for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops was their first priority, and Rhamalai was settled by technophobes, so one [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] was enough to strike fear into the entire population.
